node_types.label: Person
node_types.description: An individual at Meridian Harbor or a named contact (leads, sponsors, commercial and security staff). Always use the full name; people sharing a first name (Priya Shah / Priya Nair, Alex Kim / Alex Rivera) are different people.

properties.name: title
properties.description: Job title or function, e.g. 'procurement manager', 'Security Assurance reviewer', 'customer success manager'.

node_types.label: Team
node_types.description: A named team. Engineering teams own services; Harbor Operations is a facilities team, not an engineering team.

properties.name: function
properties.description: What the team does, e.g. 'engineering' or 'office facilities'.

node_types.label: Department
node_types.description: An organizational department, e.g. Commercial Operations or Security Assurance.

node_types.label: Service
node_types.description: An internal runtime software service or data system owned by an engineering team, e.g. Ledger service, Gatehouse, Beacon Warehouse. Not a project: Project Beacon is not Beacon Warehouse.

node_types.label: Project
node_types.description: A delivery project in the active portfolio, e.g. Project Harbor, Beacon, Orchard, Relay, Compass. Not the same as a service or team with a similar name.

node_types.label: Customer
node_types.description: A pilot or affected customer organization, e.g. Northstar Clinics, Alder Bank.

node_types.label: Supplier
node_types.description: An external vendor under contract that supplies a runtime interface or deliverable, e.g. Cobalt Clearing, Sable Trust, Pinebridge Data, Lumen Post. Cobalt Analytics is a different vendor with no runtime interface.

node_types.label: SupplierInterface
node_types.description: A supplier-provided interface that an internal service uses, e.g. clearing API, key attestation feed, ingestion connector, delivery gateway, credential appliance.

node_types.label: Contract
node_types.description: A contract, addendum or assurance schedule with a supplier, e.g. CC-17 or the Sable Trust assurance schedule.

properties.name: signed_date
properties.description: Date signed, as written in the text.

properties.name: terms
properties.description: Key obligations, e.g. notice periods or response times.

node_types.label: Deliverable
node_types.description: An artifact a supplier must deliver or a project must produce, e.g. clearing sandbox, attestation bundle, connector test harness, residency addendum, mock API, stub.

properties.name: status
properties.description: Delivery or acceptance status, e.g. 'delivered late', 'expired'.

properties.name: date
properties.description: Promised or actual date, as written in the text.

node_types.label: Milestone
node_types.description: A dated project or supplier milestone, such as a pilot date or a receipt milestone.

properties.name: date
properties.description: Date, as written in the text.

properties.name: previous_date
properties.description: Original date if it was moved.

node_types.label: Incident
node_types.description: A customer-impacting production incident, e.g. INC-031.

properties.name: date
properties.description: Date of the incident or report.

properties.name: impact
properties.description: Observed impact, e.g. '47 minute settlement outage'.

node_types.label: CorrectiveAction
node_types.description: A corrective action item tied to an incident, such as a compatibility gate, representative fixture or alert.

properties.name: due_date
properties.description: Due date if open, as written in the text.

node_types.label: Allocation
node_types.description: A funding allocation approved by a sponsor for a project.

node_types.label: Rehearsal
node_types.description: A recovery rehearsal or demonstration performed by a team in an exercise.

properties.name: name
properties.description: Short name of the rehearsal, e.g. 'settlement replay'.

relationship_types.label: LEADS
relationship_types.description: The person leads the team and is accountable for its work.

relationship_types.label: MEMBER_OF
relationship_types.description: The person belongs to the team or department.

relationship_types.label: REPORTS_TO
relationship_types.description: The person reports to another person.

relationship_types.label: PART_OF
relationship_types.description: The team sits within the department.

relationship_types.label: OWNS
relationship_types.description: The team owns the service. Ownership means responsibility for deployment approval and corrective actions; consuming a service or sponsoring a project does not confer it.

relationship_types.label: DEPENDS_ON
relationship_types.description: The consumer service directly depends on the provider service at runtime. Direction is consumer to provider.

relationship_types.label: USES_INTERFACE
relationship_types.description: The service uses the supplier interface.

relationship_types.label: SUPPLIES
relationship_types.description: The supplier provides the interface.

relationship_types.label: TARGETS
relationship_types.description: The project changes this service.

relationship_types.label: SPONSORS
relationship_types.description: The person sponsors (funds and prioritizes) the project; this is not engineering ownership.

relationship_types.label: PILOT_CUSTOMER_OF
relationship_types.description: The customer is the pilot customer for the project.

relationship_types.label: COORDINATES_COMMUNICATIONS_FOR
relationship_types.description: The person coordinates pilot communications for the customer.

relationship_types.label: WITH_SUPPLIER
relationship_types.description: The contract is an agreement with the supplier.

relationship_types.label: REQUIRES
relationship_types.description: The contract or project requires the deliverable.

relationship_types.label: DELIVERS
relationship_types.description: The supplier delivers the deliverable.

relationship_types.label: ESCALATION_CONTACT_FOR
relationship_types.description: The person is the commercial escalation contact for the supplier.

relationship_types.label: ACCEPTANCE_REVIEWER_FOR
relationship_types.description: The person is the one who records security or acceptance review for the supplier or deliverable.

relationship_types.label: HAS_MILESTONE
relationship_types.description: The project has this milestone.

relationship_types.label: DELAYED_BY
relationship_types.description: The milestone was delayed by late delivery of the deliverable.

relationship_types.label: AFFECTED_SERVICE
relationship_types.description: The incident's trigger or impact was in this service.

relationship_types.label: AFFECTED_CUSTOMER
relationship_types.description: The customer experienced the incident.

relationship_types.label: ADDRESSES
relationship_types.description: The corrective action addresses the incident.

relationship_types.label: AUTHORIZED
relationship_types.description: The person authorized the allocation.

relationship_types.label: ALLOCATED_TO
relationship_types.description: The allocation is a reserve for the project.

relationship_types.label: PERFORMED
relationship_types.description: The team performed the rehearsal.

relationship_types.label: COVERS_SERVICE
relationship_types.description: The rehearsal exercised recovery for the service.
